decision_conditions: Please be advised that this application grants permission for the partial discharge of Condition 22 in relation to Block C only. Separate application submissions are required to discharge Condition 22 in relation to other Blocks.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 22 (Rail vibration and ground-borne noise - Block C only) of planning permission ref. 1331/APP/2019/2314 dated 28-06-2021 (Development of 4 no. new buildings comprising residential units (in addition to those approved under planning permission ref: 1331/APP/2017/1883), a basement extension to Block B, flexible commercial uses (Class E) and associated landscaping, access, car parking and other engineering works).
